Here you find texts, screenshots and the logo of PaperGames. You may use them freely for articles and reviews about PaperGames.

In short

PaperGames is a free collection of {games} classic board, card and puzzle games for e-ink readers. It runs in the reader's browser and works offline after the first visit. There are no ads, no account and no tracking.

Longer text

PaperGames started with a simple wish: a chess game for an e-reader. Christopher Müller, a musician and producer from Germany, could not find one, so he built it himself. Today the collection has {games} games, from chess, checkers, Go, Shogi and Xiangqi to backgammon, sudoku, solitaire and many card games. Everything is made for e-ink screens: black and white, no animations, no sounds, no time pressure. The games run in the browser of readers such as tolino, Kobo, PocketBook and Boox, and on phones and computers. After the first visit they work without internet. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking. The interface is available in 12 languages. PaperGames is free and non-commercial.
